name: ZX_EXEMPTIONS
description: This table stores tax exemptions, which are full or partial exclusions from taxes within a given time period. Each record contains an exemption percentage of a specific tax rate for a party, party site or an item.

columns.name: TAX_EXEMPTION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier

columns.name: PROGRAM_NAME
columns.description: Program name of last concurrent program to update this record

columns.name: PROGRAM_APP_NAME
columns.description: Application name of last concurrent program to update this record

columns.name: EXEMPTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates the type of this exemption. Possible values are DISCOUNT and SPECIAL_RATE.

columns.name: EXEMPTION_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates approval status for this exemption

columns.name: TAX_REGIME_CODE
columns.description: Tax regime code for this exemption

columns.name: TAX_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Tax status code for this exemption

columns.name: TAX
columns.description: Tax for this exemption

columns.name: TAX_RATE_CODE
columns.description: Tax rate code for this exemption

columns.name: EXEMPT_CERTIFICATE_NUMBER
columns.description: Exemption certificate number

columns.name: EXEMPT_REASON_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates the reason for this exemption

columns.name: ISSUING_TAX_AUTHORITY_ID
columns.description: Party tax profile identifier for the tax authority that has issued the exemption certificate for this exemption

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_FROM
columns.description: Effective from date

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_TO
columns.description: Effective to date

columns.name: CONTENT_OWNER_ID
columns.description: Party tax profile identifier for configuration owner of this exemption

columns.name: PRODUCT_ID
columns.description: Inventory Item for this exemption

columns.name: INVENTORY_ORG_ID
columns.description: Inventory organization identifier for the item

columns.name: RATE_MODIFIER
columns.description: Percentage of the original tax rate that is exempt

columns.name: TAX_JURISDICTION_ID
columns.description: Tax jurisdiction for this exemption

columns.name: DET_FACTOR_TEMPL_CODE
columns.description: Determining factor template code for this exemption

columns.name: RECORD_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate whether the record is migrated, seeded or defined by the user

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: PROGRAM_LOGIN_ID
columns.description: Login user identifier of last concurrent program to update this record

columns.name: APPLY_TO_LOWER_LEVELS_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N Indicates if this exemption is applicable to taxes at lower levels

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: PARTY_TAX_PROFILE_ID
columns.description: Party tax profile identifier of the party for which this exemption applies

columns.name: CUST_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Internal identifier of the customer account. This column is used only for migrated records

columns.name: SITE_USE_ID
columns.description: Internal identifier of the customer site use. This column is used only for migrated records

columns.name: DUPLICATE_EXEMPTION
columns.description: Duplicate record number for this exemption when there are duplicate item exceptions and exemptions migrated

columns.name: EXEMPTION_USAGE_CODE
columns.description: Usage of the exemption (for example letter of intent).

columns.name: RECORDING_DATE
columns.description: Date the letter of intent is received from the supplier.

columns.name: PROTOCOL_NUMBER_SEQ
columns.description: Protocol number sequence to track registered letters of intent entered into the system.

columns.name: ISSUE_DATE
columns.description: Letter of intent issue date indicates when the letter was printed and sent to supplier.

columns.name: SUSPEND_FROM_DATE
columns.description: Date on which a task, event or business process suspension begins.

columns.name: SUSPEND_TO_DATE
columns.description: Date on which a task, event or business process suspension begins.

columns.name: LIMIT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount of the exemption limit.

columns.name: CLAUSE_REFERENCE
columns.description: Tax clause on which basis exemption applies to a particular supplier.

columns.name: ISSUE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag indicates if the letter is to be issued to supplier (Y or N).

columns.name: PRINT_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate if  letter is to be printed (Y or N).

columns.name: CUSTOM_CHARGE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate if custom charges includes exemption amount  (for example, custom bills).

columns.name: PARTY_TYPE_FLAG
columns.description: To indicate if the exemption is created for supplier or customer.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_EXEMPTION_DTL_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether supplier site level exemptions are defined for the party site. Valid values: Y and N.
